visual_beat: Cold open: the completion banner itself, no context. Freeze 8 frames on the word that proves it.
caption: {{ATTEMPTS}} TRIES.
notes: Banner quote must be verbatim in evidence_ref before this row is renderable.

visual_beat: Establish: mission title/objectives on screen, character standing in the world.
caption: {{OBJECTIVE_WORD1}} {{OBJECTIVE_WORD2}}
notes: Caption copies on-screen text verbatim; never paraphrases an objective.

visual_beat: First honest attempt: show the attempt, not the result.
caption: ATTEMPT {{N}}
notes: If the transcript has no line here, this beat is dropped, not invented.

visual_beat: The fail: failure state on screen (respawn, caught, timer reset).
reframe: wide, 1.06x punch-in on the fail frame
caption: {{FAIL_WORD}}
notes: A fail may only be claimed when the reset is visible OR audible.

visual_beat: Retry loop trimmed to 2 hot cuts (0.4 s each) inside the verified window.
caption: AGAIN.
notes: Repetition is compressed within the verified window only.

visual_beat: The plan: the route/loadout/position that makes completion possible.
caption: ONE THING CHANGED
notes: {{THE_CHANGE}} from transcript or visible UI only.

visual_beat: Closest call: action at 0.5x.
caption: {{SECONDS_LEFT}} SECONDS
notes: Numbers only if a counter is on screen; otherwise energy, not a number.

visual_beat: Payoff: completion moment full speed, hold 12 frames after the banner.
caption: MISSION COMPLETE
notes: Shares the evidence record with row M1-01.

visual_beat: Reaction: voice/chat/physical. Original audio +6 dB here only.
caption: {{REACTION_WORD}}
notes: Original stream audio is the accent; no music under it.

visual_beat: Aftermath UI: objective ticked, rewards, inventory change.
caption: 1 DOWN
notes: Only if a counter is legible; else use the neutral line.

visual_beat: Callback to the cold open banner, now with context.
caption: SAME BANNER
notes: Exact same source frame, so the recap cannot drift.

visual_beat: Button: freeze on last frame, caption card slides in.
caption: MISSION 2 →
notes: Editorial row: needs no footage.

visual_beat: Cold open on M2's completion banner, mirrored crop of M1.
caption: {{M2_ATTEMPTS}} TRIES
notes: M1 drifts left, M2 drifts right.

visual_beat: Setup: M2 objective + post-M1 world state (progress, unlocks).
caption: {{M2_OBJECTIVE_SHORT}}
notes: Continuity beat: proves M2 follows M1.

visual_beat: Complication in the streamer's own words.
caption: {{M2_HARD_WORD}}
notes: No invented difficulty; if he says nothing, beat is cut (short runs 43 s).

visual_beat: Setback moment: visible reset or audible frustration.
caption: {{M2_SETBACK_WORD}}
notes: Same rule as M1-04.

visual_beat: The switch: one decision that changes the run.
caption: NEW PLAN
notes: Two slots, both evidence-backed.

visual_beat: Clutch at 0.5x: last action before the banner.
caption: THIS WAS IT
notes: Longest held beat in either short.

visual_beat: Completion, full speed, hold 12 frames.
caption: MISSION COMPLETE
notes: Shares evidence with M2-01.

visual_beat: Reaction, original audio +6 dB.
caption: {{M2_REACTION_WORD}}
notes: M1 used applause, M2 claps.

visual_beat: Two-for-two: both objective ticks in one frame.
caption: 2 FOR 2
notes: That frame is the thumbnail candidate.

visual_beat: Series end card from our own brand pack.
caption: MISSION 3 →
notes: No footage needed.
